description: This header defines the class CloudStoreImplementation which implements the interfaces IStore2 and IConfiguration in the WPEFramework plugin namespace. It contains method declarations for configuration, registration, and key-value store operations, along with private member variables.

classes.name: CloudStoreImplementation
classes.description: Implements the IStore2 and IConfiguration interfaces for cloud storage operations within the WPEFramework plugin namespace.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Sets up the cloud store with the provided service shell.

methods.name: uint32_t Register(IStore2::INotification * notification)
methods.description: Registers a notification with the internal store.

methods.name: uint32_t Unregister(IStore2::INotification * notification)
methods.description: Unregisters a notification from the internal store.

methods.name: uint32_t SetValue(const IStore2::ScopeType,const string & ns,const string & key,const string & value,const uint32_t ttl)
methods.description: Sets a key-value pair in the store within the ACCOUNT scope.

methods.name: uint32_t GetValue(const IStore2::ScopeType,const string & ns,const string & key,string & value,uint32_t & ttl)
methods.description: Retrieves a value and TTL for a given key within the ACCOUNT scope.

methods.name: uint32_t DeleteKey(const IStore2::ScopeType,const string & ns,const string & key)
methods.description: Deletes a specific key within the ACCOUNT scope.

methods.name: uint32_t DeleteNamespace(const IStore2::ScopeType,const string & ns)
methods.description: Deletes a namespace within the ACCOUNT scope.
